notes: The first branch phrase carries two article morphemes but the ASV writes no the at all for it, so both go unrepresented (rule 29); the second phrase carries none and takes a supplied the.

For the six branches the present article takes the single written the even though English fronts it before the construct numeral (rules 29, 47), and the attributive article on ha-yotseim is unrepresented, the ASV writing neither a the nor a relative for it (rule 41).
